covers.quote: Add alternative text for all images.
Include an empty value, or null text, for alt text if the image is decorative. This is 2 double quotation marks with no space (alt="").
Use empty alt text (alt="") to declare it as decorative.

examples.note: Decorative icons should have null alt text.

parts.quote: A decorative printer icon: alt=""

examples.note: Informational icon with short descriptive alt text.

parts.quote: An informational printer icon: alt="Printer icon"

rules.quote: Include short alt text – less than about 100 characters – for all informative images. Decorative images should have null alt text (alt="").
rules.specification: Informative images require alt text under ~100 characters. Decorative images must have alt="".
rules.violation_condition: an informative image without alt text or with alt text exceeding roughly 100 characters, or a decorative image with non-null alt text
when: If caption or nearby text already fully describes an informative image, alt text may be empty.
rules.why: G-1, G-2: Consolidates fundamental alt text requirement and decorative null alt text into the primary rule on alt text.

covers.quote: Do not use the <longdesc> attribute.

rules.quote: use the <longdesc> attribute for extended descriptions.
rules.specification: Do not use the HTML <longdesc> attribute.
rules.violation_condition: use of the <longdesc> HTML attribute on an image or extended description
rules.why: G-4: Body specifically forbids the obsolete HTML <longdesc> attribute.

covers.quote: Include captions for all images that are not decorative

examples.note: Example of non-decorative figure with caption.

parts.quote: <figure>
<figcaption>Figure 3: Kangaroo numbers in Victoria from 1880 to 1980</figcaption>
...

rules.quote: Add captions for all images, unless they are only decorative.
rules.violation_condition: an informative or non-decorative image without an accompanying caption
when: Does not apply to purely decorative images.
rules.why: G-1, G-4: Core instruction to caption all non-decorative images.

rules.quote: Include the HTML <figcaption> element to associate the caption with the image.
rules.violation_condition: an HTML image caption implemented without the <figcaption> element within a <figure>
rules.why: G-1: Specific structural requirement for HTML image captions.

covers.quote: Use captions to acknowledge the creator or copyright holder of images in captions. Use your organisation’s referencing style.
Write the attribution as part of the caption or following the copyright material.

rules.quote: When referencing, you must attribute copyright material. This includes images and text.
rules.violation_condition: copyrighted images or material included without copyright attribution
when: Write the attribution as part of the caption or following the copyright material.
rules.why: G-2, G-4: Mandatory requirement to attribute copyrighted content.

covers.quote: For logos that are functional links to home pages, use the name of the site in the link instead of the alt text. You don’t need to add the name to the link if it is already in the text on the page.

rules.quote: Write the full name of the organisation in the logo alt text.
rules.violation_condition: logo alt text that does not include the full name of the organisation
when: For logos that are functional links to home pages, use the name of the site in the link instead of the alt text, unless already in the text on the page.
rules.why: G-2: Specific alt text naming rule for logos and its functional-link variant.

rules.quote: Align captions and titles to the left. Place captions for decorative images, such as photographs, below the image.
rules.violation_condition: a caption or title that is not left-aligned, or a photograph caption not placed below the image
rules.why: G-1: Explicit alignment and placement rule for captions and titles.

rules.quote: Capitalise the first word and proper nouns only.
rules.specification: Image titles and captions must use sentence case (capitalise first word and proper nouns only).
rules.violation_condition: title or caption for an image that uses title case or capitalises words other than the initial word and proper nouns
rules.why: G-1: Sentence case rule for image titles and captions.

rules.quote: Don’t use a full stop to end the title or caption, even if it is a complete sentence.
rules.violation_condition: a title or caption ending with a full stop
rules.why: G-1: Punctuation rule prohibiting terminal full stops in titles and captions.

covers.quote: Number titles in long documents
Number images separately from any numbered tables.

parts.quote: Figure 1: Visitor numbers to the Green Trees main walk, 2008 to 2019
Figure 2: Traffic accident rates at Green Trees Weir, 2009 to 2010

rules.quote: In long-form content, number titles that go with images using ‘figure labels’.
rules.specification: Images in long-form content must be numbered with a figure label (e.g. 'Figure 1'). Does not apply to brochures, infographics, or simple stand-alone pages.
rules.violation_condition: an image title in long-form content that lacks a numbered figure label
when: You don’t need to number images in a brochure, an infographic or a simple, stand-alone page with only a few images.
Number images separately from any numbered tables.
rules.why: G-1, G-2: Rule governing figure numbering in long-form content.

covers.quote: Some disciplines use a full stop after the number. If your organisation uses this style, apply it consistently.

parts.quote: Figure 1: Visitor numbers to the Green Trees main walk, 2008 to 2019

rules.quote: use a colon after the number to separate it from the title text
rules.violation_condition: a figure label number followed by punctuation other than a colon (unless organisational style consistently uses a full stop)
when: Some disciplines use a full stop after the number; if used, apply consistently.
rules.why: G-1, G-2: Specifies separator punctuation after figure number.

parts.quote: Figure 1: Visitor numbers to the Green Trees main walk, 2008 to 2019

rules.quote: use an initial capital for title text that comes after the colon.
rules.violation_condition: title text following the colon after a figure number starting with a lower-case letter
rules.why: G-1: Specific casing requirement for text following the colon in figure titles.
